description: Brand standings across sampled AI answers for a project via GET /api/v1/projects/:projectId/visibility: the project brand, configured competitors and the most-mentioned other brands, each with answers mentioning it, answer rate, share of brand mentions and average visibility score. days.description: Lookback window in days ending now. Default 30.
